# SVG Creator Skill for Muse

High-quality SVG creation — icons, logos, diagrams, infographics, patterns, animated graphics — built around one non-negotiable loop: write the SVG, render it, actually look at the PNG, assess, fix, repeat. A helper script (svg_loop.py) enforces the loop and flat-out refuses to deliver a file that was never rendered. Along the way it applies professional finishing techniques: 4+-stop gradients with hue shifts, five-zone lighting, colored shadows (never pure black), drop-shadow and grain filters, thick rounded lines for reliably connected limbs, and incremental building for complex figures (torso, then limbs, then head — rendering after each step). Category guidance covers stroke-grid icons, logos legible at 64px, layered landscapes, data visualizations, and repeating patterns. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: needs Python 3 for the loop script and a way to view rendered PNGs; budget iterations — 1–2 for icons, 2–3 for infographics, 5–8 for characters and figures. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
